organizations.csv: Key column acct_num: 13 blanks and 18 duplicates across 1,030 rows. Resolution strategy (dedupe, skip, or rekey) will be handled at validation.
Dates: created_on has 4 future dates; last_activity_date has 5 future dates. How to treat future dates will be addressed at validation.

Lifecycle status is required. Our proposed transform will override status to inactive for accounts dormant >18 months (rule 2). This may require coordination with subscription import to avoid violating the cross-record rule that inactive/churned orgs cannot hold trial/active subscriptions.
Country disambiguation per rule 5: when raw country is "CA" and hq_state is missing or not a recognized US/CA code, we will default to Canada (CA).
Industry code values "31" and "23" are interpreted as NAICS sections mapping to manufacturing and construction respectively.
primary_contact_email: ~39 malformed emails will be rejected by contact.email validation unless corrected; 102 are uppercase and will be lowercased during transformation.
contacts.csv: 22 contacts (1.0%) have null acct_num; contact.organization_id is required and those rows will be rejected unless the organization reference is supplied or inferred during validation.

Email: 240 addresses need lowercasing; 106 are malformed per detection. Email uniqueness is enforced within an organization; there are 66 case-insensitive duplicates across the dataset that must be reviewed per-organization at validation.
Phone: 88 numbers are too short/invalid and will be nulled by the E.164 normalization rule.
Full name splitting uses a last-space rule; multi-part surnames or mononyms may need spot checks. This single source field will populate both contact.first_name and contact.last_name.
Applying Rule 13 to infer is_primary when the explicit flag is missing may yield more than one primary per organization; validation will surface conflicts for resolution.
8 'last_touch' dates fall in the future; the field is not migrated.
Ensure that acct_num values here match the organization.organization_id values established in the organizations load, to satisfy the foreign key rule.
subscriptions.json: acct_num is used here to populate subscription.organization_id; ensure organizations are created with matching organization_id values before loading subscriptions (cross-record rule: an organization must exist before a subscription references it).
Subscription plan mapping uses seat_count for 'Legacy Gold' per Rule 7 (enterprise unless seat_count < 10, then professional).
Quarterly billing ('Q') will be converted to 'monthly' per Rule 9.
Per Rule 11, subscriptions whose status maps to 'trial' and are older than 90 days should be excluded from migration; apply this as a pre-load filter using start_date and the migration date.
seat_count has 4.1% nulls but subscription.seats is required; remediation or defaulting will be needed during validation.
start_dt (9 nulls) and renew_dt (16 nulls) are required; remediation and validation (including renewal_date > start_date) will be needed.
monthly_amount contains mixed string/number representations; the transformation strips currency markers and commas and stores the numeric value in USD without conversion per Rule 12.
A few start dates and many renewal dates are in the future per the profiles; validate against business expectations during QA.
activity.csv: This dataset does not include a dedicated activity.organization_id column; mapping 'acct_num' to activity.organization_id assumes the same value will be loaded as organization.organization_id in the organizations dataset so the reference resolves (per cross-record rules).

occurred_at contains multiple formats; we will treat timestamps without an explicit timezone as UTC and emit ISO 8601 UTC (Z). If a different default timezone is required, please advise before validation.

amount includes placeholders that will be set to null after parsing; numeric strings with symbols/separators will be normalized to decimals. Ensure this is acceptable for non-financial activity kinds where amount may be blank.
Per cross-record rules, ensure all referenced organizations exist before loading activities.
